      • showAsConfirmation

        boolean showAsConfirmation()
        Shows the element to the user in its own window with "OK" and "Cancel" buttons. Returns true when the user clicks "OK", false when they click "Cancel". Waits until a button is clicked (which also closes the window).
        Returns:
        OK or Cancel?
